subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the 14 updated pinned third-party GitHub Action revisions, including those used to mint app tokens, publish releases, and run repository automation?
rationale: This is a trust-boundary decision about executable upstream workflow code; no repository-local mechanical change can establish that the new revisions are acceptable.

options.title: Accept after upstream review
options.body: Review the updated action commit ranges at privileged workflow call sites, then merge after the branch is refreshed and required checks complete.

options.title: Hold selected actions
options.body: Keep the current pins for any upstream action whose release changes are not yet acceptable, while allowing a narrower follow-up for the reviewed safe updates.

options.title: Pause the batch update
options.body: Close or defer this broad action-group bump if the project does not want to accept the aggregate supply-chain review burden now.

recommendation.title: Accept after upstream review
recommendation.body: Review the updated action commit ranges at privileged workflow call sites, then merge after the branch is refreshed and required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available routing candidate for a repository-wide workflow, release, and supply-chain decision; file-history attribution could not be completed in the read-only sandbox.
